property_summary: After calling setMigrator(address) on the deployed C, then calling addReward(someAddress), the public getter c.migrator() returns the zero address on the reference (because setMigrator correctly stores the new migrator) but on the buggy version it also returns zero address (since setMigrator assigns nothing but addReward doesn't change migrator). However, the difference specified claims P.migrator() != M.migrator() after addReward. To make that concrete: setMigrator(0x123...), then addReward(address(this)) — on reference migrator becomes 0x123..., on buggy it remains 0. I'll use that.
